name: Force Graph Explorer
summary: D3 force-directed network graph CodeComponent with extension library. Features an SVG canvas with D3.forceSimulation, forceManyBody, forceCenter, and forceLink for physics-based layout. Nodes rendered as circles with labels, links as lines with variable stroke width. Draggable nodes using D3.drag, zoom/pan with D3.zoom. Click a node to select it and view details in a side panel Card. Nodes colored by group using D3.scaleOrdinal with theme-aware colors from useTheme. Demo data: 15 nodes (people) with 20 links (connections) across 3 groups. Uses useAppState for selected node tracking.
shortSummary: D3 force-directed network graph with draggable nodes, zoom/pan, and node detail panel
